stem: What do these lines reveal about the lake?

options.label: F
options.text: The lake is proud of how mature the listener has become.

options.label: G
options.text: The lake understands that the listener has other priorities.

options.label: H
options.text: The lake cannot relate to the listener as time passes.

options.label: J
options.text: The lake is upset about having missed parts of the listener’s life.

visual_elements: Out in the world, you grow, you change; you lead your busy life apart
